The '''Quarren headquarters''' was located in [[Quarren City]] and served as the capital for the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] people of the [[Water/Legends|water]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] commander [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]] used this facility to stage an [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|attack]] on the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] people and their [[Coral City/Legends|capital city]].<ref name="Water War" />
